Hindi verb set बुझना (bujhnā) बुझाना (bujhānā) बुझवाना (bujhvānā) From an unattested Sauraseni Prakrit [script needed] (*vijjhāyati) (compare Maharastri Prakrit 𑀯𑀺𑀚𑁆𑀛𑀸𑀯𑁂𑀇 (vijjhāvei)), from the Prakrit cognate of Sanskrit वि- (vi-, “away”) + an unattested Prakrit [script needed] (*jhai, “to burn”), itself a vernacular variant of Sanskrit क्षै (kṣai, “to burn”), from Proto-Indo-European *dʰgʷʰey-.
